summary: Security recheck after cycle 3 approved: ui-states.toml is still read at head only, validated, rendered inert with a fixed label, and changes no criterion state or protected input; cycle 3 changed no tracked file.
basis: Fix cycle 3 carried no findings, only the timed-out test check, and changed no tracked file. I reviewed the whole diff again against dfa191c. The feature file is read only through the existing read() closure: it returns nothing for a name git ls-tree did not list under the feature at head, else reads via cat-file under the 1 MiB limit. No new git or gh call, program or fetch (FR-014). Entries pass the shared validator; names go through inert(); links are Ballast-built; the label is a constant set only from the source argument; UI results never feed criterion states (FR-012). Protected inputs and the trust baseline are unchanged, per the operator's Issue #142 intake decision 2b. D-002 proposes changing the guard environment for checks; that is R2 work kept outside this diff for a human. No step has observed test_packet passing, and the test check timed out after the last cycle, which stops the run for a human regardless of this verdict.

findings.label: spec-ambiguity
findings.reason: A feature entry may name any committed path or head-commit check, including an unrelated passing one, and the packet shows it beside the criterion. The spec accepts this edge case. The fixed agent-declared label and FR-012 bound it, and the merge reviewer should judge these links like other agent-written content.
